instruction: Open the appearance settings in Chrome where you can customize the browser theme, font size, and page zoom.

metadata.explanation: Task requires the agent to navigate to Chrome's appearance settings page. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/appearance. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and get_active_url_from_accessTree getter.
metadata.verification: Reusing existing framework functions - no new functions needed. The task follows the same navigation pattern as the original but targets the appearance settings page.
